text: Discipline OverviewPedagogy is a discipline that studies educational phenomena and reveals educational laws, aiming to explore how to cultivate people, develop educational theories and optimize educational practices. It integrates knowledge from multiple disciplines such as philosophy, psychology, sociology, and statistics. It not only covers the construction of basic educational theories but also involves practical fields such as educational policies, teaching methods, and school management. Modern pedagogy also extends to cutting-edge directions such as lifelong education, educational technology, and cross-cultural education. It is a comprehensive discipline that highly combines theory with practice.
